**Section 8.3**

b. Metal purification

d. Electroplating

d. Neutron

**Section 8.7**

**7. Electrolysis of an aqueous solution of NaCl with platinum electrode produces-**

i. Hydrogen gas

ii. Chlorine gas

iii. Sodium hydroxide solution

**Which is correct?**

a. i & ii

b. ii & iii

c. i & iii

d. i, ii & iii
